market.title: Marketplace
market.lead: Offers and products from medical reps and drug warehouses for your specialty.
market.offers_empty_text: When reps or warehouses publish offers for your specialty, they will appear here.
market.dismissed_empty_text: Offers you dismiss are kept here until they expire.
market.products_empty_text: Products that approved vendors list for your specialty will appear here.
market.vendors_empty_text: Approved medical reps and warehouses serving your specialty will appear here.
market.dismiss_confirm: Hide this offer for everyone in the clinic? You can find it later under Dismissed offers.
market.dismissed_note: This offer is dismissed for your clinic.
market.supply_dialog_text: The item is created in Supplies with this vendor as its supplier. You can request restocks from the vendor by e-mail later.
market.reorder_help: You get a low-stock alert when stock reaches this level.
market.supplier_exists: {name} is already one of your suppliers.
market.item_added: The product was added to your supplies.
market.item_exists: This product is already in your supplies.
market.catalog_note: A professional catalog — contact the vendor or send a purchase order from Supplies.

rep_visits.title: Rep visits
rep_visits.lead: Times your clinic reserves for medical reps, and the visits they book.
rep_visits.cancel_confirm: Cancel this visit? The rep will see it as cancelled.
rep_visits.requests_empty_text: New visit requests from reps will appear here.
rep_visits.past_empty_text: Completed, declined and cancelled visits are kept here.
rep_visits.disabled_text: Turn them on in Settings and add the weekly times you reserve for reps.
rep_visits.disabled_text_staff: Your clinic does not accept rep visit bookings at the moment.
rep_visits.enabled_help: Approved reps and warehouses can find your clinic and book in the windows below. They never see patients or patient appointments.
rep_visits.auto_confirm_help: Otherwise each request waits for your confirmation.
rep_visits.windows_text: Clinic-wide windows can be booked with any doctor or with the clinic; a doctor's own windows only with that doctor.
rep_visits.windows_empty_text: Add the days and times your clinic sets aside for reps.
rep_visits.own_scope: You see the visits booked with you.

vendor_side.title: Visits
vendor_side.lead: Book a visit with a doctor in the times clinics reserve for reps.
vendor_side.empty_text: Find a clinic that accepts rep visits and book a time.
vendor_side.pending_title: Your account is waiting for approval
vendor_side.pending_text: You can book visits once the DocBook team approves your account.
vendor_side.find_lead: Clinics that accept rep visits. Only the clinic, its doctors and free rep times are shown.
vendor_side.no_clinics_text: Try another name, city or specialty.
vendor_side.no_times: No free times on this day. Try another date.
vendor_side.pick_date: Choose a date to see the free times.
vendor_side.purpose_placeholder: e.g. introduce a new product line
vendor_side.requested_msg: Your request was sent. The clinic will confirm it.
vendor_side.confirmed_msg: Your visit is booked and confirmed.
